scripts.build: npm run build -w @near-chat/server && npm run build -w @near-chat/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @near-chat/server" "npm run dev -w @near-chat/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @near-chat/server && npm run typecheck -w @near-chat/web && npm run typecheck -w @near-chat/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @near-chat/server && npm run test -w @near-chat/web && npm run test -w @near-chat/desktop
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:desktop
